subject.title: Sub-agent startup silence: no first-progress signal, aborted runs appear as hangs

question: Should OpenClaw add `first-progress` and typed `startup-failed` as additive core lifecycle phases, or should startup-abort visibility stay within the existing `start`/`end`/`error` contract?
rationale: The issue is valid at source level, but adding lifecycle phases is a new core event/API surface with compatibility and consumer semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Adopt additive lifecycle phases
options.body: Approve the new phases and refresh or replace the open candidate PR against the active embedded-agent/gateway/session/SDK surfaces.

options.title: Keep three lifecycle phases
options.body: Require a fix that improves startup-abort status and diagnostics using existing lifecycle phases and terminal metadata only.

options.title: Defer the contract change
options.body: Keep the issue open as a product backlog item until maintainers decide the event contract and proof bar.

recommendation.title: Adopt additive lifecycle phases
recommendation.body: Approve the new phases and refresh or replace the open candidate PR against the active embedded-agent/gateway/session/SDK surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The subagent lifecycle and registry history makes this the best available routing owner for the API-direction call.
